Convenience Group includes eight-way power driver seat with power two-way lumbar adjuster, rearview auto-dimming mirror, illuminated sun visor, dual-zone automatic temperature control, additional second-row USB port, windshield wiper de-icer, heated front seats, heated techno leather-wrapped steering wheel, remote start system, humidity sensor, reversible cargo mat, all-season floor mats, hands-free and foot-activated power liftgate

Trailhawk Convenience Group (not available with Elite Group) includes power eight-way driver seat with power two- way lumbar adjuster, additional second-row USB port, windshield wiper de-icer, heated front seats, heated Techno leather-wrapped steering wheel, remote start system and reversible cargo mat

Driver Assist Group I (must have Convenience Group) includes Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, rain- sensing/intermittent wipers, 360-degree surround view camera system, parallel and perpendicular park assist, wireless charging pad and premium LED fog lamps

Driver Assist Group III (must have Elite Group) includes Active Driving Assist system, Traffic Sign Recognition, 360-degree surround view camera system, parallel and perpendicular park assist and wireless charging pad

Driver Assist Group IV (must have Elite Group; High Altitude models only) includes Active Driver Assist system, Traffic Sign Recognition, ParkSense front and rear park assist system, 360-degree surround view camera system, parallel and perpendicular park assist and wireless charging pad

Trailhawk Elite Group includes LED projector headlamps, premium LED fog lamps, premium LED taillamps, remote start, heated steering wheel, premium leather bucket seats, power eight-way front-row seats with power two-way lumbar adjuster, driver memory seat, heated and ventilated front- row seats, windshield wiper de-icer, additional second-row USB port, reversible cargo mat, 10.25-in. TFT color cluster, 10.1-in. Uconnect radio with navigation and hands-free, foot-activated power liftgate

Limited Elite Group includes LED projector headlamps, premium LED fog lamps and taillamps, 19-in. aluminum wheels, Diamond Black exterior accents, hands-free, foot- activated power liftgate, premium leather bucket seats, power eight-way front-row seats with power two-way lumbar adjuster, driver memory seat, heated and ventilated front- row seats, additional second-row USB port, reversible cargo mat, 10.25-in. TFT color cluster and 10.1-in. Uconnect radio with navigation

Elite Interior Group (must have High Altitude package) includes premium leather bucket seats, ventilated front seats, power eight-way driver and passenger seats with power two-way lumbar adjuster, driver memory seat, additional second-row USB port, reversible cargo mat and hands-free, foot-activated power liftgate
Premium Lighting Group (must have Sun and Sound Group) includes premium LED taillamps, LED projector headlamps, premium LED fog lamps
Sun and Sound Group includes dual-pane panoramic sunroof and premium Alpine nine-speaker sound system with subwoofer (not available with Mopar rock rails on Trailhawk)
Trailer Tow Group includes Class III hitch receiver plus four-pin wiring harness

Altitude Package includes Neutral Grey Black badging, Gloss Black grille surround with Neutral Grey rings, Gloss Black daylight opening molding, black roof, Gloss Black lower rear fascia valance, 18-in. Gloss Black aluminum wheels, premium vinyl/cloth seats in black with Bright Blue accent stitching, Piano Black interior accents and 10.1-in. Uconnect radio

High Altitude Package includes Neutral Grey badging Gloss Black grille surround with Neutral Grey rings, Gloss Black daylight opening molding, black roof, body-color painted front and rear lower fascias with Neutral Grey accents, body-color painted side flares, full suite of premium LED lighting (projector LED headlamps, fog lamps, taillamps), 19-in. Satin Granite Crystal aluminum wheels, leather seats in black with Bright Blue accent stitching and Piano Black interior accents, premium Alpine audio system, dual-pane panoramic sunroof, 10.25-in. TFT color cluster and 10.1-in. Uconnect radio with navigation
